title: Il Futuro Semplice
subtitle: One tense for predictions, plans, and probability.
objectives: Conjugate regular verbs in the futuro semplice
Recognize the main irregular future stems
Use the future of probability to express a guess about the present

content.intro: The futuro semplice covers what English splits between "will" and "going to" — and it has one more job English's future doesn't: expressing a guess about right now.
content.explanation: Built from the infinitive (with -are verbs changing their a to e) plus one shared set of endings across all three conjugations. A number of very common verbs have a shortened, irregular stem that the endings then attach to.

rules.heading: a) Regular endings
rules.body: -erò, -erai, -erà, -eremo, -erete, -eranno (for -are verbs, the a of the infinitive becomes e first: parlare → parler-).

rules.heading: b) Common irregular stems
rules.body: essere → sar-, avere → avr-, andare → andr-, fare → far-, potere → potr-, dovere → dovr-, volere → vorr-, venire → verr-, vedere → vedr-, sapere → sapr- — the regular endings still attach to these stems.

rules.heading: c) Future of probability
rules.body: A guess about the present, not a real future event: Che ore sono? Saranno le tre. (What time is it? It's probably around three.) Non risponde: sarà occupato. (He's not answering: he's probably busy.)

examples.en: Next year we'll go to Japan.
It will be good weather this weekend.
I wonder who'll be at that party.

commonMistakes.wrong: Io vado studiare domani. (for a distant plan)
commonMistakes.right: Studierò domani. / Andrò a studiare domani.
commonMistakes.why: While present tense works for near, casual plans, a clearer future statement uses the futuro semplice.

commonMistakes.wrong: Io avrò vent'anni oggi. (stating a fact)
commonMistakes.why: The future is for prediction or probability, not a present fact — use the present tense to simply state your age.

commonMistakes.wrong: Farò meaning "I will make/do" spelled faro
commonMistakes.why: The accent on the final ò marks stress and is required — dropping it changes both spelling and, in writing, meaning.

items.explanation: Andare has the irregular stem andr-.
Essere's irregular future stem is sar-.
A guess about the present uses the future of probability.

summary: Common irregular stems: sar-, avr-, andr-, far-, potr-, dovr-, vorr-, verr-, vedr-, sapr-.
The future also expresses probability about the present, not just genuine future events.
